notes.title: Version 1.3.6 – Changelog
notes.content:
The wooden wallpaper background is now in higher quality.

New Chinchón rule: face cards can now be worth 8, 9, or 10 points instead of always 10.

Added a new HD wallpaper background.

General improvements and bug fixes.

We welcome any suggestions or bug reports!

Please contact us at [i]hello@quarzoapps.com[/i] before leaving a negative review, we’re happy to help.
